Heating Oil Prices Decline — US heating oil futures fell to around $4.85 per gallon on Thursday, paring recent gains alongside crude prices as investors assessed a US proposal to ease sanctions on shadow fleet tankers to reduce shipping costs and facilitate oil flows. The discussions follow President Donald Trump's temporary easing of sanctions on Russian diesel exports last week, although analysts have questioned the deal's potential to lower fuel prices given the relatively small volume involved. Meanwhile, Russia accused Ukraine of attacking two oil refineries, including the 400,000-barrel-per-day Ryazan facility, raising doubts over the prospects for an energy truce announced by Trump. Continued attacks on shipping near the Strait of Hormuz also pose risks to global oil flows. Separately, API data showed that US distillate inventories fell by 1.5 million barrels in the week ended October 9, pointing to tighter supplies.

BoJ Koeda Backs Further Rate Hikes Amid Inflation Risks — The Bank of Japan (BoJ) should not be overly cautious about further rate hikes given persistent upside price risks and still-accommodative financial conditions, board member Junko Koeda said in a speech. She called for timely policy adjustments based on economic and price developments, while considering the estimated range of the neutral interest rate. Koeda noted that price increases across a broad range of consumer items and a shift in the distribution of price changes suggest underlying inflation is becoming anchored around 2%. Stable wage growth also indicates that sustained inflation is taking hold more firmly in Japan. She stressed the need to deepen the BoJ’s analysis of economic conditions, prices, and financial markets as positive interest rates become a normal feature of economic activity.

Kiwi Dollar Edges Higher but Remains Near 2025 Lows — The New Zealand dollar rose to $0.561 on Thursday, having fallen to as low as $0.556 overnight, its weakest level since April 2025, after higher-than-expected US CPI data boosted the greenback. The report prompted traders to increase bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike later this month and a further increase in December. Domestically, while the Reserve Bank of New Zealand has resumed its monetary tightening cycle, the official cash rate remains notably lower than interest rates in several major economies, including the US and neighboring Australia, making the kiwi less attractive to yield-seeking investors. The currency has also been weighed down by a still-sluggish economy and ongoing political uncertainty. Investors will now focus on New Zealand’s third-quarter CPI report next week for clues on the interest rate outlook. The report will be the last major data release before the RBNZ’s next meeting on October 28.

China Stocks Hit Over 1-Year Low — The Shanghai Composite fell 1.4% to 3,715 on Thursday, while the Shenzhen Component dropped 1.9% to 11,874, with both indices hitting their lowest levels since August 2025 as investors weighed the potential for renewed trade tensions between China and the EU. Brussels is already considering trade measures targeting other industries, including furniture and scooters, while Germany is expected to push for restrictions on chemicals, mechanical engineering products and potentially pharmaceuticals, following last week’s agreement to limit Chinese car exports. However, China viewed the recent agreement as a calculated and one-off concession, while the Chinese state media also warned of a response if the EU introduces new measures. Energy stocks lagged, led by PetroChina (-1.3%) and CNOOC (-1.5%). Technology stocks also fell, including Cambricon Technologies (-4.6%), Zhongji Innolight (-4.1%), Eoptolink Technology (-4.8%) and NAURA Technology (-3.3%).

Sri Lanka Tourist Arrivals Extend Fall in September — The number of foreign tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka fell by 0.26% year-on-year to 158,557 in September 2026, following a 3.3% decline in the previous month. This marked the sixth year-on-year monthly decline so far this year, although cumulative tourist arrivals for the first nine months of 2026 reached 1,693,679. India continued to dominate as the top source market, accounting for 32.0% of arrivals with 51,931 visitors, followed by China with 11,722 (7.0%) and Australia with 10,951 (7.0%). The UK ranked fourth with 10,738 visitors, followed by Germany with 7,277. Despite the recent weakness, total arrivals remained 6.4% above the same period in 2018, before the pandemic disrupted international travel. Meanwhile, Sri Lanka cut its 2026 tourist arrival target to 2.7 million from 3 million and lowered its tourism revenue goal to $4.2 billion from $5 billion amid weakening visitor numbers.

AUS 10Y Yield Falls on Soft Jobs Report — Australia’s 10-year government bond yield fell to around 5.2%, hitting a five-week low after a surprisingly soft jobs report prompted investors to pare back wagers on further rate hikes. The economy shed 39,300 jobs, the biggest monthly fall since February last year, defying expectations for a 20,000 gain. The jobless rate also stayed at a five-year high of 4.7%, above the 4.6% forecast, with the previous month revised up from an initial 4.6% reading. The figures suggested the labor market may be loosening after the Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate by 1 percentage point to 4.60% this year to rein in inflation, one of the most aggressive tightening cycles among developed economies. Markets now see less than a 10% chance of a November hike, down from 35% earlier, while the odds of a December move fell to 30% from 60%. A May 2027 hike carries the highest probability at 80%. Attention now turns to Q3 CPI data due later this month for further clues on the policy outlook.

However, expectations of more aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes continued to weigh on sentiment following hotter-than-expected US inflation data. The US Consumer Price Index rose to 3.7% in September, its highest level in four months and above market forecasts of 3.6%, largely driven by rising energy costs. Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee described the figures as “discouraging” and cautioned that the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure could also be overheating the economy. Meanwhile, San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly indicated that the central bank may need to raise short-term interest rates further, although she saw no immediate need for a rate hike at this month’s meeting.

Australian Dollar Falls to Two-Week Low — The Australian dollar fell below $0.70, hitting a two-week low after higher unemployment and unexpected job cuts in September prompted traders to scale back bets on further rate hikes. The jobless rate came in at 4.7%, above the 4.6% forecast, while the previous month's reading was revised up from an initial 4.6%. The economy also shed 39,300 jobs, compared with expectations for a 20,000 gain, although full-time employment climbed by 34,400. The figures suggested the labor market may be loosening after the Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate by 1 percentage point to 4.60% this year to rein in inflation, marking one of the most aggressive tightening cycles among developed economies. Markets now see less than a 20% chance of a November hike, down from 35% earlier in the day, while the odds of a December move fell to 40% from 60%. Rate markets have also pushed back expectations for further tightening, with May 2027 carrying the highest implied probability of a hike at 80%.

【重新整理世界紀錄！我國量子網路領域實現關鍵技術突破】記者14日從中國科學技術大學獲悉，該校潘建偉、張強等與濟南量子技術研究院鄭名揚等組成的研究團隊，在紫外波段離子阱儲存器和通訊光纖的高效量子互聯方面取得重要進展。他們成功實現393奈米至1550奈米的高效率、低噪聲量子頻率轉換，重新整理該波段量子頻率轉換效率與噪聲水平的國際紀錄，為可擴充套件量子網路中囚禁離子節點的遠端互連提供了關鍵技術。相關成果發表在學術期刊《物理評論快報》上。基於以上創新方法，團隊構建393奈米至1550奈米的高效率低噪聲量子頻率轉換模組，端到端效率達28.8%，泵浦光噪聲抑制至35個/秒。與此前研究工作相比，效率提升約30倍，噪聲降低逾兩個數量級，創造了該波段量子頻率轉換的新紀錄。研究人員介紹，該量子頻率轉換模組已在基於鈣離子囚禁離子的遠距離量子糾纏中得到實際應用，訊雜比可達120∶1，支撐了長壽命遠端離子—離子高保真度糾纏的實驗演示與器件無關量子金鑰分發，為可擴充套件量子中繼和廣域量子網路奠定了關鍵器件基礎。

【前特斯拉高管掌舵，引領Uber貨運業務轉型】Rebecca Tinucci 出任 Uber Technologies 旗下物流部門的負責人，目標是讓這項貨運業務完美融入這家全球頂尖的科技巨頭。上任一年後，儘管該部門仍處於虧損狀態，但她的領導已初見成效。今年8月，Uber Freight 報告了三年來的首次連續兩個季度實現年度營收增長。儘管全行業需求疲軟，但透過其網路處理的貨運量依然有所增加。此外，Tinucci 表示，越來越多的客戶正將更大比例的物流需求交由該公司處理。作為 Uber Freight 的執行長，她在首次接受採訪時表示：“如今，貨主們更願意、也更傾向於與更少的供應商合作，以簡化他們的供應鏈。”

【China reports record quantum frequency conversion enabling trapped‑ion telecom links】Researchers at the University of Science and Technology of China and the Jinan Quantum Technology Research Institute reported a high‑efficiency, low‑noise quantum frequency conversion from 393 nm (UV) to 1,550 nm (telecom) that enables interfacing trapped‑ion memories with optical fiber. The team led by Pan Jianwei, Zhang Qiang and Zheng Mingyang said the result sets an international record for conversion efficiency and noise in this wavelength range and provides key technology for remote interconnection of trapped‑ion nodes in scalable quantum networks. The findings are published in Physical Review Letters.

【中信期貨：白銀短線震盪偏弱執行，關注本週美國PPI、零售資料和沃什講話】日內海內外白銀大幅下跌，其中COMEX白銀跌幅超5%、昨夜一度跌至56美元/盎司附近，受美元指數走強及美債收益率高位壓制。美國9月核心CPI同、環比均高於市場預期，表明通脹黏性仍存，推動市場上修美聯儲10月加息機率，美元及美債收益率同步上行，對白銀金融屬性形成進一步壓制。地緣方面，胡塞武裝襲擊沙特能源設施及霍爾木茲海峽周邊航運風險仍存，能源供應不確定性支撐油價高位執行，可能進一步增加後續通脹壓力。現貨層面，內外盤現貨仍寬鬆，倫敦市場白銀租賃利率低位執行。整體來看，白銀金融屬性偏空，工業屬性支撐有限，資金熱度亦偏弱。（中信期貨）

【中金：預計美聯儲10月仍可能暫停加息 12月再度行動】中金公司研報稱，美國9月CPI季調環比上漲0.6%，同比上漲3.7%；核心CPI環比上漲0.3%，同比上漲2.6%，均較上月反彈，且超出市場預期。漲價來源較廣，能源、核心商品及房租均形成推動。油價高企加劇能源通脹，消費韌性與AI投資需求支撐商品價格，租金粘性則制約服務通脹回落。貨幣政策方面，通脹反彈強化了美聯儲繼續加息的必要性，但由於近期美債收益率上行、美元走強，金融條件已部分收緊，美聯儲或保持耐心。中金預計10月仍可能暫停加息，12月再度行動。不過，加息節奏放緩並不意味著貨幣政策轉向寬鬆，未來一年，美聯儲或仍將維持偏緊的政策立場。

【摩根大通：並無“審慎理由”促使美國削減20年期國債發行】儘管市場“盛傳”美國財政部官員可能在週五公佈的一份調查問卷中，就削減20年期國債發行徵詢一級交易商意見，但摩根大通策略師認為，財政部“沒有審慎理由”這樣做。該行全球利率策略主管Jay Barry牽頭的團隊寫道，市場參與者“正迫不及待地等待11月季度再融資的一級交易商調查問卷，該問卷定於美國東部時間週五中午釋出”。“過去兩週，我們無數次被問到，財政部是否會藉此機會詢問削減甚至徹底停止發行20年期國債”。“出於多方面原因，我們認為探詢此類舉措並不審慎。”首先，“鑑於預算赤字仍然龐大，加之到期債務增加，財政部未來幾年將面臨顯著的融資缺口”。“其次，目前並不明視訊記憶體在長端市場失衡”。“最後，雖然這樣做可能暫時壓低長期收益率，但參考英國債務管理辦公室和日本財務省削減長端債券發行佔比的經驗，我們並不確定此舉能夠產生持久影響”。

Australian Shares Drop Further on Wall Street Jitters, Jobs Data — Australian stocks fell 42 points or 0.5% to 8,686 in early Thursday trading, extending losses to their weakest level in a week. A sharp Wall Street sell-off hit sentiment after hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation data rattled tech stocks and revived bets on Fed hikes. Locally, September jobs data showed the unemployment rate stuck at a near five-year high of 4.7% as employment unexpectedly declined. In major trading partner China, September CPI quickened but undershot forecasts, while producer prices rose more than expected; exports and imports surged to record highs, driving a strong trade surplus. Sectoral losses were led by tech, non-energy minerals, industrial services, and consumer durables, partly offset by gains in communications, consumer non-durables, and utilities. Heavyweight BHP Group slumped 3.8% despite securing a deal to avert a strike at Chile’s Escondida copper mine. Other major laggards included Goodman Group (-3.8%), Lynas Rare Earths (-3.7%), and Codan Ltd. (-3.4%).

Japan’s Nikkei Slumps on Hot US Inflation — The Nikkei 225 Index fell more than 3% toward the 65,000 level on Thursday, extending its losing streak to six consecutive sessions and reaching a two-week low as stronger-than-expected US inflation fueled concerns over higher interest rates. Japanese equities also followed an overnight technology-led selloff on Wall Street, as rising borrowing costs threatened the sector’s credit outlook amid substantial investments in artificial intelligence. AI-related stocks led the declines in Japan, with Kioxia Holdings falling 9.1%, Advantest dropping 7.4%, Lasertec losing 8.8%, SoftBank Group sliding 7.8% and Taiyo Yuden declining 4.5%. Banking stocks also weakened, including Mitsubishi UFJ and Sumitomo Mitsui, both down 1.1%, while Mizuho Financial fell 1.8%. Meanwhile, Japanese data showed that core machinery orders, a key indicator of capital investment, increased more than expected in August.

【Bolivia revises gold export rules to attract dollar inflows】Bolivia is overhauling gold export rules to boost USD inflows and dollar deposits at domestic banks, ending a three-year central bank-regulated certification regime. Under the new rules exporters must prove to mineral and metals trade regulator SENARECOM that at least 80% of export proceeds are deposited in Bolivian financial institutions; exporters will no longer need a central bank-issued certificate to ship gold. The reform, backed by the president and announced Wednesday, is aimed at increasing foreign-exchange inflows, improving USD availability and tightening oversight of gold exports.

【美參議員蒂利斯呼籲國防部監察長調查SpaceX“星盾”斷網事件】美國參議員湯姆·蒂利斯（Thom Tillis）已公開呼籲國防部監察長（DOD Inspector General）對涉及 SpaceX 衛星技術的重大服務中斷事件展開調查。該呼籲源於近兩日對烏克蘭軍隊使用的空間通訊網路施加的重大速度限制事件。蒂利斯指出，最新報告表明該“戰略性失誤”（strategic snafu）可能發生在國防部內部的 “星盾”（Starshield） 系統中，而不是由民用星鏈（Starlink）或 SpaceX 直接造成。由於他對國防部長皮特·海格塞斯主動提供透明度不抱期望，因此將要求國防部監察長介入調查並向國會及美國公眾報告。在此前針對埃隆·馬斯克的 X 貼文中，蒂利斯曾嚴厲警告，在俄軍持續襲擊時實施網路降速，導致了烏克蘭平民以及美國外交與安全人員處於不必要的危險之中。他直言，故意削弱烏克蘭的自衛能力“在最壞的情況下，可能會被解讀為在共謀並協助一場大規模謀殺”。

Australia Jobless Rate Highest in Nearly 5 Years — Australia’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate stood at 4.7% in September, unchanged from an upwardly revised figure in August and above expectations of 4.6%. It was the highest since October 2021, with the number of unemployed increasing by 8,900 to 732,000, the highest since April 2021. Meanwhile, employment unexpectedly fell by 39,300 to 14.78 million, defying expectations for a rise of 20,000.

Australia Employment Unexpectedly Falls — Employment in Australia dropped by 39,300 to 14.78 million in September 2026, reversing a downwardly revised 29,300 increase in the previous month and missing market expectations for a 20,000 gain. Part-time employment decreased by 73,700 to 4,550,200 people while full-time employment increased by 34,400 to 10,232,400. The employment-to-population ratio fell to 63.6% from 63.9% in August, and the participation rate eased to 66.8% from 67.0%. Compared with a year earlier, total employment expanded by 168,300, or 1.2%.

【海關總署：最佳化進境糧食企業監管措施及有關事宜】海關總署釋出《關於最佳化進境糧食企業監管措施及有關事宜的公告》。其中明確，進境糧食應當在具備防疫、處理等條件的指定加工企業進行加工使用。海關發現相關企業存在以下違規情形的，除依法追究相關企業責任外，要求其限期整改：（一）未按規定實施植物疫情監測及防除措施；（二）未按規定記錄進境糧食接卸、運輸、存放、加工、下腳料處理、發運流向等資訊；（三）進境糧食未按規定在指定企業加工、存放；（四）未按規定在進境糧食裝卸、運輸等環節採取防止撒漏、密封等防疫措施；（五）未按規定對進境糧食實施有效的除害處理或加工處理；（六）未按規定對下腳料、包裝材料實施無害化處理；（七）拒絕接受海關檢疫監督。如發現指定企業存在上述（四）（五）（六）（七）情形，在整改完成前，對後續擬運往該指定企業的檢疫審批申請，海關不予許可。

【AI financing fears, rising rate worries hit chip shares】Global tech-hardware selloff continued Thursday as rising Fed-hike odds and funding strains in AI weighed on chip names. Asian semiconductor stocks tracked U.S. weakness: Samsung Electronics fell more than 7% and SK Hynix dropped over 8%, dragging the KOSPI down as much as 6%. Japan's Nikkei index slipped more than 3%; Tokyo Electron and Screen Holdings were off about 3%. Investors cited higher rates, stretched valuations and the massive capital required for AI infrastructure; strong results from Samsung and ASML failed to reassure markets. AI cloud provider CoreWeave plunged and its bonds fell to levels typically seen in distressed credits, renewing doubts about the sustainability of large AI-infrastructure outlays. Wednesday data showed U.S. September CPI rose to a five-month high, lifting market expectations for further Fed tightening.
【鵬華“網紅”經理謝添元卸任 曾因工位擺滿Labubu出圈】近日，鵬華基金髮布公告，宣佈謝添元因個人原因離任鵬華優選回報靈活配置混合型證券投資基金（006526）基金經理，新任基金經理為黃奕彬，離任日期為2026年10月9日。這位因工位擺滿Labubu、重倉泡泡瑪特而走紅全網的“95後”基金經理，就此結束了他管理公募產品的短暫生涯。
【中信證券：建議重點關注具備全球競爭力的中國家電龍頭】中信證券研報稱，貿易壁壘、成本優勢與本地需求共同推動白電龍頭加快東南亞建廠，中國家電龍頭海外經營由產品出口轉向產能、研發、品牌和渠道協同佈局。面對約3萬億元的全球家電市場，中國企業憑藉供應鏈效率、產品迭代及本土化能力，有望持續搶佔日韓及歐美品牌份額，推動海外收入與盈利中樞穩步提升。建議重點關注具備全球競爭力的中國家電龍頭。

【中信證券：深度受益於載板化升級趨勢 國產ABF載板蓄勢待發】中信證券研報稱，ABF封裝基板作為受益於AI成長邏輯最持續的PCB產業環節之一，深度受益於PCB載板化的升級趨勢，有望迎來市場空間和利潤的快速爆發。中信證券判斷行業的產能缺口在短期內或將持續擴大，行業漲價有望持續，此外分別從國產板廠及國產客戶的視角切入研究，判斷當前已成為國產ABF載板全面起量的關鍵節點，看好國產廠商ABF載板業務未來的業績彈性。

【CITIC Securities: Still expect Fed to hold in October then hike in December】CITIC Securities says US September CPI exceeded expectations; core month-on-month inflation remained hot and price increases were broad, leaving inflation not falling to target quickly enough. It still expects one more Fed hike this year — a pause in October followed by a 25bps increase in December. With oil prices elevated and inflation sticky, US financial conditions are unlikely to ease materially; dollar liquidity should remain tight, US Treasury yields lack clear downside, and gold sentiment remains fragile. Fundamental resilience matters more than liquidity-driven odds.

【一次性擴崗補助“免申即享” 深圳用人單位注意查收政務簡訊，回覆確認公示3日即領1000元/人】記者從深圳市人力資源和社會保障局獲悉，2026年一次性擴崗補助開始申領啦，旨在穩就業、促發展、惠民生。只要本年度招用的新員工符合相應條件企業或社會組織就能獲得1000元/人的一次性擴崗補助。此次發放物件主要是企業或社會組織，機關事業單位不適用。對2026年1月1日至2026年12月31日之間招用畢業年度及離校兩年內未就業高校畢業生、16—24歲登記失業青年，簽訂勞動合同併為其足額繳納3個月以上失業、工傷、職工養老保險費的企業或社會組織，按每招用1人1000元的標準發放一次性擴崗補助。（深圳特區報）

【湖南省委書記沈曉明主持召開推動全省氫能產業發展座談會】據湖南日報，10月14日，湖南省委書記沈曉明主持召開推動全省氫能產業發展座談會，廣泛聽取各方面意見建議。在認真聽取大家發言後，沈曉明指出，要充分認識發展氫能產業的重大意義，積極搶抓國家戰略機遇，立足湖南省在區位條件、政策支撐、產業基礎、技術底座和應用場景等方面的優勢，把氫能作為湖南省未來產業發展的重點領域和主攻方向。要堅持有所為、有所不為，瞄準制氫裝備、氫燃料電池、氫能終端等重點賽道精準發力，確保取得更多標誌性成果。要加大對氫能產業的支援力度，健全產業支援政策，提供更加廣泛的應用場景，推動科技創新和產業創新深度融合。要加強統籌排程，謀劃推進氫能重大專案和基礎設施建設，培育氫能龍頭企業和專精特新企業，推動創新平臺建設和產學研協同創新，在財稅、產業基金、投融資等方面加大支援力度，建立健全氫能安全監管制度和標準規範，形成齊抓共管的工作合力。

【US weighs easing sanctions on 'shadow fleet' to lower record-high shipping rates】An administration official said Wednesday the Trump administration is considering easing sanctions on so-called 'shadow fleet' vessels that previously carried oil and petroleum products from Russia, Iran and Venezuela, aiming to reduce global shipping rates, which remain at historic highs. The official said discussions focus on whether to allow previously sanctioned ships to transport 'legitimate oil'—crude or products not subject to U.S. sanctions, explicitly excluding sanctioned Russian or Iranian cargoes—to push more crude and refined flows out of the Gulf region. The move follows Trump’s recent temporary waiver of sanctions on Russian diesel, a decision criticized by Ukrainian President Zelenskiy, several European governments and some Republican senators.

Japan Machinery Orders Rebound More than Expected — Japan’s core machine orders, which exclude volatile sectors such as ships and electric utilities, rose by 5.2% month-on-month to JPY 1,069.8 billion in August 2026, reversing a 3.7% decline in the previous month and exceeding market forecasts for a 3% gain. It marked the fourth month of increase so far this year, supported by rebounds in both manufacturing orders (1.6% vs -1.0% in July) to JPY 527.0 billion and non-manufacturing orders (2.9% vs -2.6%) to JPY 541.3 billion. Among manufacturers, non-ferrous metals posted the strongest growth (132.6%), followed by other transport equipment (43.7%), petroleum and coal products (19.6%), and automobiles, parts, and accessories (13.1%). In the non-manufacturing sector, goods leasing (136.0%), wholesale and retail trade (29.2%), and mining and quarrying posted solid rises. On an annual basis, machinery orders increased by 18.6%, up from 11.2% in July and above consensus of 15.7%. It was the fastest yearly growth in six months.

【長鑫科技釋出新型技術架構 海外龍頭壟斷壁壘面臨重估】國產儲存龍頭長鑫科技釋出新型技術架構，全球儲存龍頭股價近期明顯回撥。10月13日，三星電子、SK海力士跌幅超過7%，10月14日跌幅收窄企穩。業內人士向證券時報記者分析，國際儲存巨頭暴跌，短期是交易層面的情緒超調，長期來看反映了市場對其壟斷壁壘的重估，而未來伺服器市場會面臨分化。報道顯示，10月10日，長鑫科技總裁曹堪宇博士在第四屆整合晶片和芯粒大會上公佈公司在DRAM器件、4F^[2]架構及混合鍵合等方向進展，並預計年底推出融合新技術的新一代DDR5 RDIMM產品。相比DRAM行業主流6F^[2]架構，4F^[2]意味著每個單元僅佔4倍最小特徵尺寸的平方，因此單位面積內的電晶體數量會增多，實現儲存密度的提升。該技術最核心的特色是在DRAM儲存陣列電晶體上的創新，即自研的VSG（Vertical Surrounded Gate）電晶體。

【證券日報：中國資產對國際資本吸引力持續提升】2026年以來，外資機構對中國資產加強調研、調高評級、加大持倉。這一趨勢背後，折射出國際資本對中國經濟韌性、產業升級成效與科技創新實力的高度認同。外資機構的調研節奏，是觀察其對A股公司興趣的直觀視窗。萬得資料顯示，截至10月14日，年內已有超650家外資機構累計調研A股公司6300餘次。其中，高盛（亞洲）證券以164次調研位居首位，Point72資產管理公司、美銀證券、摩根大通等外資機構的調研次數也均超過100次。 從調研行業分佈看，積體電路、機器視覺、工控自動化、電氣裝置等高階製造領域的上市公司更受外資機構關注。瀾起科技股份有限公司、‌奧比中光科技集團股份有限公司、深圳市匯川技術股份有限公司‌分別被81家、72家、57家外資機構列入自身關注度前三，新業務放量節奏、產線擴產與交付情況、下游業務應用場景等問題被重點關注。

【今年前三季度兩岸進出口貿易額同比增30.3%】海關總署14日公佈的最新統計資料顯示，今年前9個月，大陸與臺灣進出口貿易額同比增長30.3%，內地與香港進出口貿易額同比增長55.6%。資料顯示，今年前9個月兩岸貿易額約3011.8億美元。其中，大陸從臺灣進口約2162.8億美元，同比增長27.8%；大陸向臺灣出口約849億美元，同比增長37.3%。從單月看，9月兩岸貿易額約417.7億美元。其中，大陸從臺灣進口約298.4億美元，向臺灣出口約119.3億美元。（看臺海）
【前9個月柳州鐵路港鐵路發貨量超194萬噸】隨著平陸運河建成通航，柳州鐵路港正在加緊完善多式聯運，降低物流運輸成本。最新資料顯示，今年1至9月，柳州鐵路港鐵路傳送貨物194.56萬噸，達2025年全年的1.88倍；集裝箱發運量1.7萬標箱，為2025年全年的22倍。

【臺積電財報面臨高門檻 僅超預期或難平息全球AI板塊拋售潮】在全球晶片大廠強勁業績未能提振人工智慧(AI)交易之際，臺積電週四將公佈的財報若要打動投資者，勢將面臨相當高的門檻。受加息、AI基礎設施融資以及晶片景氣週期能否持續等擔憂影響，費城半導體指數連續六個交易日下跌，市值累計蒸發逾1.5萬億美元。臺積電此前已公佈季度營收大增51%。不過，三星電子和阿斯麥近期公佈的穩健業績仍未能緩解市場對晶片股的焦慮。打動投資者的“門檻非常高”，Financiere de L Echiquier投資組合經理Kevin Net表示。“要推動股價出現積極反應，僅僅超出預期還不夠。”他希望看到臺積電維持較高利潤率和資本支出，同時釋放AI和高效能算力需求依然強勁的訊號。
基準10年期日本國債期貨早盤上漲0.26點。
日本日經225指數期貨早盤下跌3.1%。

【“茶百道們”被停牌背後——港股監管亮劍嚴查IPO認購操縱】10月13日，新茶飲品牌茶百道港股交易被緊急停牌。當日，香港證監會給出叫停的理由，該股首次公開招股（IPO）可能曾被人為操縱。監管方面稱，有關可疑集團涉嫌參與茶百道、撥康視雲、天聚地合等IPO欺詐計劃。 在茶百道之前，另外兩隻股票已被停牌。停牌只是表象，更深層是，IPO認購需求被人為製造的問題，正被監管擺在明面重拳整治。專業人士告訴北京日報記者，人為安排製造認購熱度，可能誤導投資者對市場需求和證券價值的判斷。儘管有關問題有待監管進一步調查，但釋放出的訊號已極其明確：對IPO操縱行為“零容忍”。（北京日報）
U.S. 10-year Treasury yield fell 4 bps to 5.1539%.
美國10年期公債收益率下跌4個基點至5.1539%，受股市下滑和信貸壓力影響。
【黃仁勳再駁“AI滅絕論”】英偉達CEO黃仁勳在週三的一次採訪中再次駁斥了所謂的“AI滅絕論”。針對多位行業高管發出的“人工智慧可能帶來生存風險”的警告，他表示，這項技術“完全在我們的掌控之中”。黃仁勳說：“我不明白為什麼會有人想要支援某種技術的發展——畢竟這種技術最終可能會導致我們所熟知的人類文明走向終結。所以，如果他們真的相信這一點，那他們確實應該停止相關研發工作。”
日經指數期貨在新加坡交易所開盤下跌1,850點，報66,310點。
【財政部向金融央企注資事項迎新進展】財政部向金融央企注資事項迎來新進展。10月14日晚間，工商銀行、農業銀行、中國人保同步釋出公告，回覆上交所就這三家機構定增申請檔案出具的稽核問詢函。公告顯示，問詢函內容主要關注行政處罰、訴訟仲裁兩大問題。這三家機構的回覆總體一致，認為上述問題不會對此次發行構成障礙。（人民財訊）

【通用世界模型北京市重點實驗室揭牌 】世界模型作為人工智慧的前沿方向，正成為全球科技競爭的新賽道。日前，在2026世界模型高峰論壇上，通用世界模型北京市重點實驗室揭牌。據悉，這也是國內首個世界模型方向的省部級重點實驗室。通用世界模型北京市重點實驗室依託單位極佳視界創始人兼CEO黃冠表示，通用人工智慧不能只停留在語言智慧，更需要具備在物理三維空間中理解、生成、預測和行動的能力，而這些能力的實現有賴於通用世界模型的突破。

【黃仁勳與奧特曼唱反調：不應容忍AI引發的任何網路安全事件】英偉達執行長黃仁勳表示，人工智慧行業不應容忍由該技術引發的任何網路安全事件。這一觀點與OpenAI執行長薩姆·奧特曼的看法相左，後者最近聲稱，為了獲得人工智慧帶來的益處，世界或許不得不接受“一些糟糕事件”的發生。黃仁勳在週三的一次採訪中表示：“我無法容忍任何網路安全事件的發生。我們根本不應接受這類事件，我們應當竭盡所能去避免它們。”黃仁勳說，迄今為止發生的這些事件，本都可以透過對AI智慧體實施更嚴格的管控與監測來避免。

【前三季度港股IPO募資超3800億港元 前三家承銷商承銷規模合計佔比達42%】2026年前三季度，港股IPO市場交出一份遠超預期的成績單，共有115家企業上市，募資總額3855.66億港元，這一募資規模已超過2011年以來任何一年的全年水平。市場火熱也讓中介機構受益。記者注意到，頭部效應十分明顯，前三家承銷商的承銷規模合計佔比已達42%。不過，保薦機構的資源緊張問題以及執業質量仍然受到監管關注。

【科技日報：限制中國無人機，美方無疑是自尋煩惱】據美國全國公共廣播電臺（NPR）10月12日報道，美國對中國無人機的限制正在損害資金短缺的警察部門，由於預算緊張，一些部門不得不四處奔走，尋找途徑來購買更昂貴的本土無人機。報道援引美國執法無人機協會主席喬恩·比爾的觀點稱，中國製造的無人機比美國無人機“領先幾光年”。比爾介紹，大疆創新（DJI）的一款配備高解析度熱成像攝像頭的無人機售價不到1萬美元，美國無人機價格通常在2萬到5萬美元之間，效能還要遜色不少。當前，無人機正在越來越深地嵌入經濟發展、公共安全、城市治理、農業生產、民眾生活等各個領域。限制中國無人機不僅不會成為美國無人機產業發展的“保護傘”，反而會在不同應用場景中帶來種種本不應存在的問題。美方應聽取各行業無人機使用者的意見，一意孤行恐怕將遭受更大的損失。

【Analysts: TSMC likely to report record profit for sixth straight quarter】Analysts expect TSMC to report on Thursday Q3 net profit up 65% YoY to NT$746.3 bln (about $23.4 bln), driven by a surge in tech infrastructure spending and strong demand for AI-chip manufacturing capacity and CoWoS advanced packaging. If final net profit exceeds NT$706.56 bln, it would be a company single-quarter record and mark 11 consecutive quarters of profit growth.

Brent Holds Firm on Heightened Supply Risks — Brent crude traded near $106 per barrel on Thursday, holding recent gains as escalating hostilities in the Middle East and Eastern Europe heightened concerns over supply disruptions. A container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday after being hit by unidentified projectiles, while Iran-backed Houthi forces continued missile and drone attacks across Saudi Arabia. More oil tankers are steering clear of their usual crude-loading areas, indicating that increased Iranian attacks on shipping are disrupting export operations. Meanwhile, Russia accused Ukraine of striking two oil refineries on Wednesday, including the 400,000-barrel-per-day Ryazan facility, violating an “energy ceasefire” announced by US President Donald Trump. In the US, API data revealed that crude inventories fell by 11.1 million barrels last week, marking the largest decline since June 2025.

【證監會：穩步拓展期貨市場對外開放廣度深度】中國證監會期貨監管司副司長王穎10月14日在第19屆國際油脂油料大會暨農畜產業（衍生品）大會上表示，立足“十五五”時期戰略部署，面對新形勢新任務，證監會期貨司將牢牢把握市場化、法治化、國際化方向，著力推動建設安全、規範、透明、開放、有活力、有韌性的期貨市場。穩步拓展市場對外開放廣度與深度，最佳化境外主體參與渠道，完善跨境監管協作，加強與國際交流互鑑，共同提升全球大宗商品定價效率和風險管理能力。（中證報）

【專家稱未來觀察信貸供需應更關注利率變化】根據記者從央行瞭解到的最新資料，9月貸款利率繼續保持低位。9月份企業新發放貸款加權平均利率略低於3%，比上年同期低約0.2個百分點。“當前企業貸款利率、發債利率等主要融資價格指標處於低位水平，也是社會融資環境保持寬鬆的重要體現，表明資金供給比較充裕，實體經濟有效融資需求得到充分滿足。”業內專家告訴記者。業內專家表示，未來應主要透過利率來觀察信貸供需匹配的情況。近年來，我國貫徹新發展理念、推動高質量發展取得積極成效，產業結構深度調整，增長動能新舊轉換，信貸供需形勢反映了經濟結構轉型。信貸和其他商品一樣，應以滿足人民群眾生產生活需要為宜，不需要過多關注規模增長。未來要淡化對信貸規模的關注，更多關注價格，即市場利率的變化。（中國金融時報）

Oil Holds Advance on Heightened Supply Risks — Crude oil traded near $95 per barrel on Thursday after rallying for five straight sessions, underpinned by escalating hostilities in the Middle East and Eastern Europe that heightened concerns over supply disruptions. A container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday after being hit by unidentified projectiles, while Iran-backed Houthi forces continued missile and drone attacks across Saudi Arabia. More oil tankers are steering clear of their usual crude-loading areas, indicating that increased Iranian attacks on shipping are disrupting export operations. Meanwhile, Russia accused Ukraine of striking two oil refineries on Wednesday, including the 400,000-barrel-per-day Ryazan facility, violating an “energy ceasefire” announced by US President Donald Trump. In the US, API data revealed that crude inventories fell by 11.1 million barrels last week, marking the largest decline since June 2025.

【特朗普稱洩密者應被槍斃 這次洩密迫使他重新安排一次打擊伊朗的行動】美國總統唐納德·特朗普在競選集會上猛烈抨擊他認為對伊朗戰爭的批評性報道，並呼籲處決向媒體洩露資訊的人。“依我之見，洩密者應該被槍斃。他們就應該被槍斃。以前，我們就是這麼對待洩密者的。”特朗普在亞利桑那州布林黑德市的競選活動上說道，“洩密者必須受到非常非常嚴厲的懲罰。他們真實存在。在我看來，他們是人渣。”特朗普週三提到他所稱的對伊朗的打擊行動，該行動動用了美國在密蘇里州的軍事力量。他表示，由於關鍵細節洩露，他不得不重新安排這次行動。他沒有具體說明指的是哪次行動，也沒有提供任何直接證據證明向媒體洩露資訊迫使五角大樓更改了任何軍事計劃。
【前三季社融增量超二十七萬億 股債融資佔比近半】中國人民銀行10月14日釋出的最新金融統計資料包告顯示，今年前三季度，廣義貨幣供應量（M2）和社會融資規模存量增速均保持在7%以上的合理水平，同經濟增長、價格總水平預期目標相匹配，反映當前宏觀政策持續積極有為，有力支撐金融總量合理增長。社融增量分項資料顯示，前三季度，債券和股票融資在社融增量中的佔比約49.48%，超過貸款佔比約7個百分點。
【前三季社融增量超二十七萬億 股債融資佔比近半】中國人民銀行10月14日釋出的最新金融統計資料包告顯示，今年前三季度，廣義貨幣供應量（M2）和社會融資規模存量增速均保持在7%以上的合理水平，同經濟增長、價格總水平預期目標相匹配，反映當前宏觀政策持續積極有為，有力支撐金融總量合理增長。社融增量分項資料顯示，前三季度，債券和股票融資在社融增量中的佔比約49.48%，超過貸款佔比約7個百分點。
【人民日報評多個行業協會撤銷“大師”稱號：把虛名清掃一空，讓實幹蔚然成風】今年以來，整治注水“大師”持續加碼。中國整形美容協會、中國建築防水協會等行業協會，相繼宣佈撤銷多個“大師”“傳承大師”等稱號。清理虛假名號、摒棄浮華噱頭，建立規範化行業標準和評價體系，品質、實力、服務、口碑、創新才能成為經營主體的共同追求。

【市場行情極致切換 基金追高科技很“受傷”】今年以來，A股市場結構性分化極致演繹。科技板塊上半年狂飆，卻在三季度勢頭戛然而止。在劇烈的風格切換中，部分前期“踏空”科技股的主動權益基金經理囿於相對排名的壓力，在歷史高位跟風上車，最終在行情反轉中慘遭“兩頭捱打”。相反，前期被冷落的紅利板塊下半年則逆勢領跑，因此能夠堅守醫藥、紅利或高股息的基金產品，即使錯過了前期風口，年內也多數取得了正收益。有分析指出，基金經理必須認識到，沒有任何一種投資風格可以永遠適應所有市場環境，因此基金經理要敬畏估值，重視“盈虧同源”的投資法則。

【調整孕育配置機會 寬基ETF整體獲大規模淨申購】近期A股市場震盪分化，各大主要寬基指數迎來明顯回撥，盤面整體呈普跌格局。值得注意的是，在當前市場環境下，資金反而呈現明顯的越跌越買特徵，寬基ETF整體獲得大規模淨申購，資金借道寬基指數工具佈局A股核心資產的趨勢較為顯著。整體來看，市場快速回撥過程中，增量資金借道寬基ETF實施逆市申購，配置重心顯著向科創50、創業板指等高彈性、前期超跌的成長寬基傾斜，同時小幅增配滬深300、上證50等藍籌指數作為組合防禦底倉。這一資金行為，一方面反映機構資金對市場中期維度具備配置價值的判斷，也意味著“調整孕育配置機會”的逆向佈局邏輯，正在被主流資金落地。

【證券日報：汽車行業該擺脫銷量焦慮了】國內市場承壓既是消費需求變化的結果，也是產業走向成熟必須經歷的過程。中國汽車產業經歷多年快速擴張，正在進入由規模增長向質量提升轉變的關鍵階段。看待產業發展，不能簡單地以銷量增減判斷，更不必因短期資料波動而過度焦慮。評價汽車產業發展，不能只盯著銷量增長率，還要看技術進步、產品質量、企業盈利能力以及全球市場競爭力。銷量可以反映市場熱度，卻不是衡量產業實力的唯一標準。要防止銷量壓力演變為非理性競爭。能夠在市場波動中保持合理利潤和持續創新能力的企業，才真正具備長期競爭優勢。中國汽車產業已經走過依靠規模快速擴張的發展階段，接下來更需要的是有質量、有利潤、可持續的增長。銷量有起伏，市場有周期，都是產業發展的正常現象。真正值得警惕的不是增長速度暫時放緩，而是為了維持增速而透支產業未來。

Inflation over the past three months is 1.7%. We inherited extremely bad inflation from Biden and are now performing very well."

【英偉達支援的AI製藥公司Iambic IPO定價16美元，預計募資1.5億美元】當地時間10月14日，人工智慧製藥公司Iambic Therapeutics宣佈首次公開募股（IPO）定價，每股16美元，發行937.5萬股，預計募資1.5億美元，承銷商另獲30天內額外購買最多140.625萬股的選擇權。公司股票預計於10月15日在納斯達克全球精選市場掛牌交易，股票程式碼為“IAM”，發行預計於10月16日完成。摩根大通、傑富瑞、美國銀行證券和花旗集團擔任聯席簿記管理人。Iambic利用人工智慧與自動化化學、生物實驗技術推進藥物研發，其候選藥物IAM1363已進入臨床階段。英偉達曾參與支援該公司的融資。

【新韓金融擬斥資 1.2 萬億韓元收購樂天非壽險業務】《韓國經濟日報》援引投行匿名訊息源稱，新韓金融集團計劃合計投入 1.2 萬億韓元，用於收購樂天非壽險保險並對其實施資本重組。新韓已同意以 6933 億韓元收購 JKL Partners 持有的 77.04% 股權，計劃明年透過要約收購等方式拿下樂天保險剩餘股權。在將樂天保險變為全資子公司後，新韓計劃把樂天保險與新韓 EZ 財產保險合併，並透過配股向合併後的保險公司注入 3000 億韓元新增資本金。收購完成後，樂天保險計劃實施約 4600 億韓元的減資操作，以此滿足將於明年生效的韓國保險資本監管標準 K-ICS 的核心資本要求。

【紅利基金淨值集體逼近新高 三大因素推動走強】近期，A股市場繼續調整，此前領跑的成長板塊開始明顯承壓，前期積累的漲幅逐步回吐，資金的風險偏好隨之收縮，市場重新回到對“確定性”的尋找之中。在這樣的背景下，一類長期被忽視的資產重新進入視野——以銀行、煤炭、公用事業為底倉的紅利主題基金，淨值正集體逼近甚至重新整理歷史高點。單看紅利主題的指數類產品，10月12日，建信滬深300紅利ETF單位淨值創下成立7年以來的新高，報1.6854元，年內回報5.84%。國泰上證國有企業紅利ETF與銀河上證國有企業紅利ETF在8月31日雙雙重新整理歷史紀錄後短暫回落，近期再度衝高，距前高僅0.03元，年內收益分別達13.99%與13.88%。在業內人士看來，支撐紅利基金走強的因素主要有三個：一是利率環境抬升了紅利的相對吸引力，二是長線資金的配置需求在持續釋放，三是分紅的制度基礎在不斷夯實。
新韓金融擬斥資 1.2 萬億韓元收購樂天非壽險業務。

【得州起訴嬰兒食品製造商嘉寶，指控產品重金屬超標】得克薩斯州州總檢察長肯・帕克斯頓週三宣佈，得克薩斯州起訴美國最大嬰兒食品生產商，指控該公司明知產品含有超標砷、鉛等有害物質，卻對外宣傳產品安全且經過檢測。帕克斯頓對嘉寶產品公司及其母公司雀巢美國公司提起訴訟，指控其行為違反該州虛假商業行為與消費者保護相關法律。這份 10 月 9 日提交至得州科林縣地區法院的起訴狀顯示，帕克斯頓尋求超過 1000 萬美元的民事罰款。
中國地震臺網正式測定：10月15日07時16分在新疆塔城地區烏蘇市（北緯43.92度，東經83.95度）發生3.1級地震，震源深度17千米。

【摩根士丹利CEO對AI建設“雙倍超配”，預計行業年支出或維持1萬億美元】當地時間10月14日，摩根士丹利執行長泰德·皮克（Ted Pick）表示，該行對人工智慧基礎設施建設已經達到“雙倍超配”，但他同時警告，AI支出增長勢頭將開始趨緩。皮克表示：“我們從早期開始就超配AI。考慮到AI不僅對我們的客戶很重要，對我們自己也很重要，我會說我們現在是雙倍超配。”皮克表示，目前AI基礎設施建設的支出平均每年約1萬億美元，“這是非常大的一筆錢”。他認為支出未必會從這一水平繼續加速增長，但完全有可能再以這一規模維持十年。

【英偉達支援的AI製藥企業Iambic透過美國IPO融資1.5億美元】臨床階段抗癌藥物研發及技術企業IambicTherapeuticsInc.完成美國首次公開發行，融資1.5億美元，發行價定在推介區間中點。週三公告顯示，這家有英偉達公司參股的企業，以每股16美元的價格發行約938萬股。此前申報檔案顯示，Iambic原定發行價區間為每股15至17美元。按本次IPO發行價，結合申報檔案披露的已發行股份，這家總部位於聖地亞哥的公司市值為7.58億美元。申報檔案顯示，Iambic運用人工智慧與機器學習技術研發新療法。公司將把本次IPO募集資金用於推進三款處於早期階段的抗癌候選藥物。
【灣芯展一線觀察：千餘家企業齊聚 在手訂單充足】10月14日，2026灣區半導體產業生態博覽會（簡稱“灣芯展”）在深圳開幕。本屆灣芯展匯聚1000餘家優質企業，覆蓋晶圓製造、化合物半導體、先進封裝、IC設計/AI基礎設施等細分領域。多家參展企業表示，目前半導體市場需求旺盛，在手訂單充足。（中國證券報）

【利好不斷提振市場關注度 遊戲板塊估值價效比凸顯】近期A股遊戲板塊出現連續反彈行情。Wind資料顯示，10月14日，短劇遊戲、網路遊戲等市場概念板塊漲幅居前，與遊戲相關的傳媒板塊近幾個交易日成為主力資金淨流入的主要方向，多隻個股表現活躍。在業內人士看來，年初至今國內遊戲版號審批節奏已逐步趨於平穩，行業供給端預期持續鞏固，將持續推動各遊戲企業儲備新品進入測試、上線週期，帶動板塊業績逐步兌現。在經歷調整後，當下遊戲板塊估值價效比凸顯，看好基本面支撐下的板塊估值修復機遇。（中國證券報）

【Report: US considered unfreezing some Russian assets to spur peace talks; Europe shocked】The Financial Times, citing four people, reported the US proposed that European governments unfreeze part of Russia’s sovereign assets frozen after the Ukraine war and transfer them to a Washington-controlled body to try to restart peace talks. How assets would be unfrozen and how proceeds would be used remain under discussion. The idea was floated at a Miami meeting last week attended by Trump’s peace envoy and officials from Ukraine, France, Germany, the UK, the EU and NATO, but European representatives rejected it. European governments and Kyiv said they were shocked, raising questions about US intent and signalling a markedly different US posture on ending the Russia-Ukraine war.
【美國股指期貨亞洲早盤下跌 CPI資料超預期加劇美聯儲加息擔憂】繼隔夜美股大盤重挫後，美國股指期貨週四亞洲早盤繼續下跌，此前公佈的9月CPI資料高於預期，加劇了市場對於美聯儲進一步加息的擔憂。標普500指數期貨一度下跌0.3%；納斯達克100指數期貨一度下跌0.7%。標普500指數週三收跌1.1%，創下7月29日以來最大單日跌幅。
Coinbase：印度部分使用者或在法幣入金設定環節遭遇延遲，或無法完成該設定。

【豐富底層投資工具 公募配置盤蓄勢待發】公募基金多資產配置的熱潮愈發旺盛。近日，證監會就《公開募集證券投資基金運作管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》及配套規則公開徵求意見。其中，多項圍繞基金投資範圍的鬆綁條款引發行業關注，如非FOF產品投資其他基金的比例上限擬從10%上調至30%、允許FOF投資ETF聯接基金等。此外，FOF成立門檻擬降至5000萬元。在業內人士看來，這是一組為資產配置型產品“量身定製”的鬆綁條款，將進一步拓寬相關產品的策略空間，提升基金組合的配置效率。未來，公募基金將更加強調多資產組合管理能力，而天然具有資產配置屬性的FOF和“固收+”產品將是各家公募機構競爭的重要方向。（中國證券報）
【廣交會開幕之際 白雲機場口岸迎來入境客流高峰】第140屆廣交會今天（15日）在廣州開展，連日來，白雲機場口岸迎來入境客流高峰。根據廣州邊檢總站白雲邊檢站統計，廣交會期間，白雲機場口岸預計出入境客流超120萬人次，同比增長13.6%，出入境交通工具超6500架次，同比增長17.6%。目前口岸開設了廣交會邊檢專用通道，增配多語言智慧終端與志願服務力量，便利來華客商順暢通關。
小鵬汽車董事長何小鵬在2026巴黎汽車峰會上呼籲深化全球合作，重點推介"小鵬AI工程"。
【內地與香港綠電證書集中交易完成】從南方電網瞭解到，昨天（14日）我國內地與香港的可再生能源綠色電力證書集中交易完成，所成交綠證對應的電量近1億度。本次綠證集中交易由廣州電力交易中心和香港交易所聯合組織開展，共有6家內地新能源發電企業與9家香港使用者參與交易，覆蓋銀行金融、地產物業、教育服務等多個行業，共成交綠證9.6萬個，對應可再生能源電量近1億度。
【湖南釋出大霧黃色預警，區域性能見度低於200米】湖南省氣象臺10月15日7時釋出大霧黃色預警：預計15日早晨，湘北、湘中大部分地區將出現能見度不足500米的雨霧，區域性能見度低於200米，將對交通產生較大影響。黃色預警區域：長沙、株洲北部、湘潭、湘西州中部、常德中東部、益陽、岳陽、婁底、邵陽東部、衡陽北部。
白宮人工智慧工作組首次會議將於明日舉行。
【爭奪終端定義權 智慧體手機行業迎來新博弈】近期，隨著努比亞、階躍終端相繼釋出或迭代智慧體手機，該賽道步入加速落地階段。手機端側AI備案加速擴容、相關新品密集登場，AI正試圖改寫智慧手機的互動邏輯，一場關於終端定義權的行業博弈悄然開啟。與此同時，跨應用執行、資料安全、生態協同、成本管控等多重挑戰亟待行業破解，智慧體手機能否扛起新一輪換機週期的大旗，仍待市場給出答案。（上海證券報）

【中央氣象臺釋出暴雨藍色預警 局地將有雷暴大風等強對流天氣】中央氣象臺10月15日06時繼續釋出暴雨藍色預警：預計，10月15日08時至16日08時，貴州東北部、湖南中北部、湖北東部、江西北部、安徽西南部等地部分地區有大雨，其中，湖南中北部、湖北東部、江西北部、安徽西南部等地部分地區有暴雨（50～90毫米）。上述部分地區伴有短時強降水（最大小時降雨量20～50毫米，局地可超過60毫米），局地有雷暴大風等強對流天氣。

【北向資金三季度調倉 銀行、醫藥板塊持倉市值增幅顯著】10月14日，滬深股通2026年三季度末持股資料出爐，北向資金三季度動向也隨之浮出水面。資料顯示，截至2026年三季度末，北向資金共持有3531只個股，持倉總規模為2.577萬億元，較二季度末的3.127萬億元回落超5500億元，但與一季度末的2.572萬億元基本持平。結構上，北向資金三季度對紅利、醫藥板塊增配較多，減配AI、出海鏈等方向。分行業看，北向資金對銀行板塊的持股市值較上季度大幅上升673.36億元，環比增加47%，增幅位居31個申萬行業榜首，同期銀行板塊指數整體漲幅超16%。此外，醫藥生物、非銀金融、交通運輸、家用電器、食品飲料等大金融、大消費板塊的北向資金持股市值增幅顯著。
Samsung Electronics fell 6% and SK Hynix fell 7% in Seoul pre-market trading. Overnight, U.S. memory and storage names declined broadly.
【美國提議解凍部分俄羅斯資產以重啟烏克蘭和談】據報道，美國政府已向歐洲盟友提議，解凍部分因烏克蘭戰爭而被凍結的俄羅斯主權資產，以此作為推動並重啟俄烏和平談判的經濟誘因。根據英國《金融時報》和《紐約時報》的最新披露，特朗普政府在近期的秘密外交接觸中，向莫斯科釋放了重大讓步訊號，試圖以此換取區域性停火或減緩對關鍵基礎設施的襲擊。

【央行釋出前三季度金融統計資料 社融增量超27萬億元 直接融資佔比上升】中國人民銀行10月14日釋出的前三季度金融統計資料顯示，9月末，廣義貨幣（M2）餘額、社會融資規模存量、人民幣貸款餘額分別同比增長7.2%、7.1%和4.8%，增速較上個月有所回落。業內專家表示，貸款、債券都是信用擴張的重要形式。今年以來，債券、股票等直接融資增長提速，適配新質生產力領域融資需求，對信貸形成了良性補充和替代，金融支援高質量發展的適配性提升。

【新加坡霧霾達到 “非常不健康” 級別，考慮採取法律行動】新加坡空氣質量惡化至非常不健康水平，該國將保留對涉事企業提起法律訴訟的所有選項。新加坡《海峽時報》週三援引永續發展與環境部部長傅海燕訊息，新加坡正在收集霧霾相關資料，評估依據《跨境煙霾汙染法》採取行動的可能性。該法案於 2014 年生效，針對引發或縱容火情的責任方；若火情造成的煙霾使空氣汙染指標（PSI，空氣質量衡量指標）連續 24 小時及以上處於不健康區間，即可適用該法追責。截至當地時間早上 6 時，全島空氣汙染指數介於 125 至 206 之間，西部地區讀數最高。24 小時 PSI 達到 201 及以上即為 “非常不健康”；指數超過 300 屬於 “危險” 級別，將觸發停課措施。

【Russia says it expanded control in Kharkiv; Ukraine reports large-scale offensive in Donetsk】On the 14th the Russian Defence Ministry said Russian forces expanded control in the Kharkiv region, seizing three settlements including Kotovka, and struck 146 Ukrainian targets, naming drone production/storage workshops and temporary billets for Ukrainian troops and foreign mercenaries. Moscow said its forces also used drones to hit a logistics hub used to store and distribute supplies for Ukrainian forces and a dry-cargo vessel carrying dual-use military-civilian goods. Also on the 14th the commander of Ukraine’s Third Corps said Ukrainian forces in Donetsk blocked a Russian flanking encirclement of the Sloviansk–Kramatorsk area, retained control of the Kharkiv–Sloviansk road, launched a large-scale offensive and during the operation restored full control over 16 settlements.

New Zealand Stocks Track Wall Street Lower — The NZX 50 lost 69 points, or 0.5%, to 13,691 in Thursday morning deals, after a slight gain in the previous session, tracking a decline on Wall Street overnight as faster-than-expected inflation data raised expectations of Fed rate hikes. Rising oil prices pressured sentiment amid concerns over inflation and the RBNZ's tightening monetary policy, after the central bank hiked interest rates in July and September. 【頂級預測師：美聯儲12月可能加息50個基點】Prestige Economics總裁Jason Schenker表示，FOMC可能會在12月考慮更大幅度、達50個基點的加息。這位較早預測到美聯儲最近一次加息的預測師Schenker如今認為，美聯儲可能在9月加息後“讓政策效果稍作喘息”，再於12月考慮更大幅度加息。Schenker預計，若12月出現更大幅度加息，明年年初可能暫停進一步加息。 在10月和12月會議之間，美聯儲官員還將收到兩份就業報告和另一份CPI資料，可為其未來決策提供依據。Schenker表示：“雖然只需等待6周，但他們將獲得更多資料。如果他們發現25個基點毫無作用，那麼我認為他們可能會推出50個基點的加息。”Schenker預計，更大幅度的加息可能導致明年年初暫停進一步加息；而如果12月僅加息25個基點，則明年第一季度再次加息的可能性較大。

【俄稱擴大在哈爾科夫的控制區 烏稱在頓涅茨克發動大規模進攻】俄羅斯國防部14日通報稱，過去一天，俄軍擴大了在哈爾科夫地區科托夫卡等三處居民點的控制區。俄軍在146個區域對烏方進行打擊，目標包括生產和儲存無人機的車間及烏軍人員和外國僱傭兵臨時駐紮地點。此外，俄軍當天還利用無人機打擊了烏方一處用於儲存和分發供烏軍所使用物資的物流中心，以及一艘運輸軍民兩用物資的乾貨船。烏克蘭第三軍團指揮官14日表示，在頓涅茨克地區，烏軍阻止了俄軍從側翼迂迴包抄斯拉維揚斯克-克拉馬托爾斯克城市群，仍控制哈爾科夫至斯拉維揚斯克的公路，並發動大規模進攻。整個行動期間，烏軍已將16個居民點重新置於烏克蘭全面控制之下。（央視新聞）

【Chinese regulators crack down on ‘long-duration’ products; ‘quick-return’ bancassurance offerings halted】Regulators have issued a notice to inspect and rectify 'quick-return' insurance products sold through the bancassurance channel, requiring life-insurance legal entities to conduct self-examinations and strictly implement reporting alignment between insurers and banks. The notice flags products with 3-year premium payment periods and 6-year coverage—ordinary and participating endowment policies—that deliberately compressed actuarial expense assumptions and returned cash value quickly to boost reported scale, creating a risk of treating long-duration insurance as short-term business.

【加大住房消費支援力度，多地落實住房公積金新政】9月20日，新修訂的《住房公積金管理條例》正式施行。《條例》落地以來，多地因地制宜最佳化住房公積金政策，明確開展自住住房裝修提取住房公積金等業務。例如，10月12日，長春市住房公積金管理委員會發布《關於調整住房公積金使用政策的通知》，貫徹落實《條例》，明確支援提取住房公積金裝修自住住房等舉措。上海易居房地產研究院副院長嚴躍進分析稱，各地因地制宜落實《條例》，裝修提取住房公積金上限從10萬元至30萬元不等，與當地房價水平和住房存量特徵基本匹配。（證券日報）

【豐富底層投資工具，公募配置盤蓄勢待發】近日，證監會就《公開募集證券投資基金運作管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》及配套規則公開徵求意見。其中，多項圍繞基金投資範圍的鬆綁條款引發行業關注，如非FOF產品投資其他基金的比例上限擬從10%上調至30%、允許FOF投資ETF聯接基金等。此外，FOF成立門檻擬降至5000萬元。在業內人士看來，這是一組為資產配置型產品“量身定製”的鬆綁條款，將進一步拓寬相關產品的策略空間，提升基金組合的配置效率。未來，公募基金將更加強調多資產組合管理能力，而天然具有資產配置屬性的FOF和“固收+”產品將是各家公募機構競爭的重要方向。（中證報）

【巴克萊：特斯拉-SpaceX合併訊息可能在年度股東大會前公佈】巴克萊分析師表示，市場參與者目前普遍預計特斯拉將與SpaceX合併，相關訊息可能會在特斯拉年度股東大會(AGM)之前公佈。分析師Dan Levy等人預計，2026年年度股東大會最遲將於12月6日舉行。Levy補充稱，合併的理由將是實現垂直整合，並能夠加快埃隆·馬斯克旗下兩家公司在人工智慧(AI)領域的發展機會。“雖然特斯拉/SpaceX合併訊息的公佈時間可能會推遲到10月晚些時候，甚至可能推遲到11月初，但我們認為，屆時要讓合併案在年度股東大會上獲得批准，難度可能會越來越大。”

US Crude Inventories Post Largest Draw Since January — US crude oil inventories fell by 11.12 million barrels in the week ending October 9th, far exceeding expectations for a 1.9 million-barrel increase and marking the largest draw since late January. In the previous week, crude stocks fell by 2.09 million barrels. Meanwhile, Cushing inventories rose by 1.82 million barrels, following an increase of 866,000 barrels in the prior week. Gasoline inventories increased by 1.1 million barrels in the week ending October 7th, while distillate stocks fell by 1.5 million barrels. US crude oil production rose to 13.98 million barrels per day in the week ending October 2nd, up from 13.95 million bpd a week earlier.

【Japan aims for 30 rocket launches per year in early 2030s】METI plans to add launch pads at four domestic sites to reach about 30 rocket launches per year in the early 2030s, citing rising security and commercial satellite launch demand. Expansion covers Space Cotan’s Hokkaido spaceport, Space One’s Kii spaceport, and JAXA’s Uchinoura and Tanegashima centers. Each site currently has a single pad; added pads are intended to allow launch preparations to run in parallel with existing operations. METI is seeking roughly ¥76 billion (about $480m) in its FY2027 budget request for the build-out and will coordinate policy with the Ministry of Finance by end-2026.

【Eight U.S. states sue OpenAI over alleged ChatGPT safety failures】On Wednesday eight U.S. states filed suit against OpenAI, accusing the company of misleading users about ChatGPT's safety and failing to provide safeguards that they say contributed to suicide, self-harm and violent behavior among users, including minors. Arkansas's complaint alleges OpenAI's leadership acknowledged the risks and employees repeatedly raised serious safety concerns, yet the company accelerated releases of increasingly powerful models without sufficient testing or protections, prioritizing growth and profit. Joining Arkansas are Arizona, Iowa, Idaho, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia; all state attorneys general except Arizona are Republicans. The states seek court orders to force changes to OpenAI's safety operations, stronger protections for children and monetary damages.

【U.S. FMC proposes $200,000 fee for Spanish ships, import limits on olive oil】The U.S. Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) proposed measures to retaliate against Spain, including a $200,000 fee on Spanish-flagged vessels docking at U.S. ports and import restrictions on key Spanish exports such as olive oil. The FMC said Spain in 2024 refused berthing for three U.S. vessels on grounds their cargo was related to Israel’s war in Gaza; after an investigation the agency found Spain’s actions disadvantaged U.S.-flagged ships. Proposed import curbs would target olive oil—Spain’s largest export to the U.S.—and cosmetics, other oils and ceramics. The measures are not yet effective and are subject to a 60-day public comment period.

Ibovespa Slips Amid Weak Economic Data — The Ibovespa edged down 0.2% to close at 206,506 on Wednesday in a volatile session amid weak economic data and an unfavorable external backdrop. Services activity contracted 0.1% in August, missing expectations for a 0.5% increase. Brazil’s Industrial Business Confidence Index rose 1.3 points to 46.2 in October but remained below the 50-point threshold, marking 22 consecutive months of pessimism. Oil prices extended their gains, stoking concerns over energy-driven inflation, while hotter-than-expected US CPI data pressured lenders amid increasing bets of a the Federal Reserve’s rate hike. Major banks declined, with Itaú down 1.4% and Bradesco losing 2.5%. Other financial stocks also fell, with B3 shedding 1.9% and Itaúsa losing 1.6%. Miners extended their losses, with Vale down 0.7% as Chinese iron ore prices continued to decline. In contrast, Petrobras rose 2.2% as oil prices resumed their climb. Investors awaited a new presidential runoff poll after the market close.

TSX Falls as Banks and Miners Slide — The S&P/TSX Composite Index fell 1.1% to close at 35,584 on Wednesday, weighed down by losses in the banking and mining sectors. Oil prices extended their gains, stoking concerns over energy-driven inflation, while hotter-than-expected US CPI data pressured lenders amid increasing bets of a the Federal Reserve’s rate hike. Major banks declined, with BMO and National Bank both shedding 0.9%. Miners extended their losses as gold and silver prices continued to fall, with Agnico Eagle down 4.6%, Barrick losing 4% and WPM shedding 4.8%. In technology, Celestica plunged 9.2% as US chipmakers posted sharp losses, while Shopify fell 2.2%. In contrast, energy producers mostly advanced as oil prices resumed their climb, with Suncor up 1% and Imperial Oil adding 0.6%. Retailers also gained, with ATD rising 2.9% and Loblaw advancing 2.8%.

Brent Rises on Middle East Tensions — Brent crude rose to around $106 a barrel on Wednesday amid renewed attacks across the Middle East and the IEA’s latest assessment of the oil market. The agency’s October Oil Market Report warned that constraints in diesel markets could persist well into 2027, with fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia threatening to derail a recovery in global oil supply. Fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthis continued to escalate, with Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Energy reporting an overnight attack on an administrative building belonging to oil giant Saudi Aramco. The incident followed a series of Houthi attacks on Riyadh over the past week. A Saudi-led coalition reportedly struck Houthi energy terminals and fuel reserves in Yemen. Meanwhile, tensions between the US and Iran remained elevated. US Central Command rejected claims by the commander of Iran’s IRGC Navy that the Strait of Hormuz was under Iranian control and that any approaching US Navy warships would be “sunk.”.

US Stocks Dip Amid Hot Inflation and Chipmaker Weakness — US stock indices closed lower on Wednesday amid hotter-than-expected inflation data and continued volatility in the AI infrastructure sector. The S&P 500 fell 1.1%, the Nasdaq slipped 2%, and the Dow shed 49 points. Chipmakers extended this week’s losses after ASML said it could not keep pace with demand for semiconductor fabrication equipment, while Chinese competitors introduced improved products approaching the capabilities of US and South Korean firms. Meanwhile, headline and core inflation readings reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve could deliver another rate hike this year. Nvidia lost 3.2%, Broadcom fell 3.1%, Micron declined 4.1% and AMD tumbled 5.7%. Among financial stocks, Bank of America fell 4.8% after both equity and fixed-income trading revenues missed estimates. Morgan Stanley closed 2.7% lower despite beating forecasts for equity-trading revenue, while BlackRock added 0.7% after stronger asset-management inflows boosted fee revenue.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed down 47.96 points, or 0.09%, at 51,622.14 on Wednesday, Oct. 14; the S&P 500 closed down 85.95 points, or 1.10%, at 7,719.50; the Nasdaq Composite closed down 511.51 points, or 1.88%, at 26,692.87.

【通脹火爆點燃10月加息預期 沃什曼谷講話或成關鍵風向標】美國9月通脹意外升溫，重新點燃了市場對美聯儲可能在本月加息的預期。此前數週，由於央行官員釋放出他們有時間等待的訊號，一度令本月加息看起來可能性不大。美聯儲主席沃什曾誓言不會以自己對近期貨幣政策前景的看法來引導市場。但這次通脹資料意外走高令外界更加關注紐約時間週四晚間他在曼谷的發言。屆時，他將與國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)總裁格奧爾基耶娃進行爐邊談話。由於議息會議即將到來，美聯儲將在本週六進入所謂的靜默期。這意味著如果央行要就本次會議可能作出的利率決定釋放訊號，或許只能由主席沃什來傳遞。美銀的美國利率策略師Meghan Swiber表示，投資者“等待沃什週四為美聯儲繼續加息開綠燈”。當談到通脹資料時，Swiber表示：“這次物價上漲的範圍相當廣，美聯儲難以對此置之不理。”

【王毅會見俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫】當地時間14日，中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅在巴庫會見俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫。
王毅祝賀俄方成功舉行國家杜馬選舉，順利完成國內重要政治議程。王毅表示，今年5月和8月，習近平主席同普京總統舉行了富有成果的會晤，引領中俄新時代全面戰略協作夥伴關係持續高水平發展。下個月，亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人非正式會議將在深圳舉行。相信在俄方等各方支援下，APEC“中國年”將取得豐碩成果，攜手重振亞太共同體歷史程序，為亞太地區發展合作注入強勁動力。
王毅表示，亞歐大陸地域廣袤、文明多元，地區國家期盼維護和平穩定、深化多邊協作。亞信峰會時隔4年再次舉辦，中方願同包括俄方在內的亞信成員國密切協作，踐行真正的多邊主義，為完善全球治理貢獻力量。
拉夫羅夫表示，俄中在兩國元首戰略引領下，持續推進兩國關係和各領域合作，取得豐碩成果，符合兩國根本利益。俄方全力支援中方辦好APEC領導人非正式會議。俄中在國際事務上立場相近，俄方願同中方進一步增進在聯合國、二十國集團、APEC、金磚機制等多邊框架下的協作，共同維護國際公平正義。
雙方還就下一步中俄高層交往以及共同關心的國際地區熱點問題協調了各自立場，達成了新的共識。（新華社）

【Yemen government seeks US intelligence and training support, not seeking talks with Houthis】Yemen’s foreign minister Afraa Zuba said Wednesday the government has asked the United States for intelligence and training support for government forces and the coast guard and for continued political, economic and humanitarian assistance, without explicitly requesting US military aid. She urged the US to expand sanctions on the Houthi movement and to strengthen sanctions coordination with the EU. Zuba said the government is not seeking negotiations with the Houthis now, prioritizing military action to end Houthi control; she said such operations are decided, commanded and executed by Yemen, with coalition partners providing air support. On US contacts with the Houthis referenced by former President Trump, Zuba said the outreach was intended to warn the Houthis against further attacks but gave no timing or communication details.

【Iran speaker Ghalibaf says Iran must fight while negotiating to force US to accept demands】Iranian parliament speaker Ghalibaf said negotiating and US promises cannot guarantee Washington will stop attacking Iran. He outlined a two-stage strategy: first win strategic advantage through fighting, then use that leverage to compel the US to accept an understanding, converting military gains into political benefits, resources and time to strengthen deterrence. He said fighting alongside negotiations does not imply endless war but aims to pressure the enemy into accepting Iran’s legitimate demands. Ghalibaf accused the US of breaking prior commitments and said Washington must be punished, change its behavior and ultimately accept Iran’s terms.

【Fed's GOOLSBEE: September inflation disappointing; more data needed before further hikes】Chicago Fed President GOOLSBEE said US September inflation surprised to the upside: core services inflation remains above 5% and core goods price gains have not eased as expected, implying inflation may be more persistent. He warned that if core inflation stays at a monthly annualized pace near 4% it would be wholly unacceptable and require policy action. GOOLSBEE said it is unclear whether current rates are sufficient to return inflation to the 2% target and he favors waiting for more data before deciding on further hikes, but cautioned that if inflation readings remain at current levels in coming months the Fed cannot stand pat. He highlighted a very tight labor market, strong growth, robust consumer spending and potential additional overheating from AI investment; firms in his district report little recession risk and widespread concern about rising costs and prices. If employment remains firm while inflation stays above target and moves in the wrong direction, the Fed must act to prevent further overheating.

【Fed's Beige: High oil prices hit all 12 districts; firms expect further price rises】Fed's Beige reports overall U.S. growth but broadly weak momentum: among 12 Fed districts, two reported moderate growth, three slight, four modest and three flat. Manufacturing held up relatively well while consumer spending was little changed in most districts and, in over half, concentrated among higher-income households. On inf, three districts reported strong price gains, eight reported moderate gains and four said price increases accelerated from the prior period. All districts cited higher oil prices—elevated diesel and fuel surcharges are transmitting costs through supply chains—while tariffs, insurance and other commodity prices continue to pressure input costs. Some firms expect further price increases in coming months as existing contracts expire and hedges or delivery contracts are renegotiated. Employment was broadly unchanged but shortages of technical and skilled workers persist; five districts said some firms have reduced headcount via attrition, delayed hiring or expect fewer new roles following AI-driven productivity investments. Rising inf and benefits costs are pushing stronger wage demands. Most firms remain cautiously positive on the near-term outlook but expect limited growth and ongoing risks from energy prices, tariffs and other uncertainties.

【Trump: GlobalFoundries to build $21 bln NY fabs; Japan to fund; Korea to commit $50 bln to Alaska LNG】President Trump announced GlobalFoundries will invest $21 billion to build two large semiconductor fabs in Malta, New York, with funding provided by Japan under a prior trade agreement. The project is expected to create about 27,000 construction and supply‑chain jobs and more than 1,000 high‑skilled manufacturing roles. The administration said the U.S. government will take an equity stake in GlobalFoundries; the Commerce Department will add $955 million for silicon photonics, SiGe and advanced packaging, bringing total Commerce investment to $1.63 billion, and the government’s stake is said to exceed $2 billion. Trump also announced the launch of the Alaska LNG (AlaskaLNG) project, described as Alaska’s largest-ever energy infrastructure project; under an earlier trade and investment deal, South Korea will invest $50 billion. He said the project is now a federal government project, all required permits and authorizations are in place, and work can proceed immediately.

CAC 40 Rises as Luxury Stocks Rebound — The CAC 40 rose 0.6% to close at 7,783 on Wednesday, rebounding from the previous session’s losses, supported by gains in luxury and industrial stocks. Luxury shares recovered after falling in the previous session amid weak results from LVMH, which cited softer Chinese demand. Hermes rose 0.9%, LVMH added 1.4%, and Kering gained 1.5%. The rebound followed Chinese foreign trade data showing that imports climbed 31% year-on-year to a record high in September, supported by seasonal restocking ahead of the major October Golden Week holiday. In the industrial sector, defense-related stocks led gains amid ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, with Airbus rising 2% and Thales gaining 1.8%. Meanwhile, ECB President Christine Lagarde played down speculation about intervention in France’s budget crisis, saying that solutions to the country’s precarious fiscal situation would need to come from domestic policymakers. Financial stocks closed lower.

European Stocks Close Higher — European equities closed higher on Wednesday, resisting sharp losses in North American equity markets amid positive corporate developments for local corporate giants. The Euro STOXX 50 added 0.5% to 6,195 and the STOXX Europe 600 advanced 0.5% to 638.0. ASML rose by 1.2% after it beat earnings and revenue expectations and issued a strong sales forecast for the fourth quarter. Brazil Industrial Confidence Improves in October — Brazil’s Industrial Business Confidence Index rose 1.3 points to 46.2 in October 2026 from September. Despite the improvement, the index remained below the 50-point threshold, marking 22 consecutive months of pessimism in the industrial sector. The increase was driven entirely by improved expectations, particularly regarding companies’ own business conditions. The Expectations Index climbed 2.1 points to 49.3, with the component measuring expectations for companies’ own business conditions rising 1.0 point to 52.3. Expectations for Brazil’s economy increased 4.3 points to 43.4. Meanwhile, the Current Conditions Index fell 0.2 point to 40.0, its lowest level since July 2020. The decline reflected a more negative assessment of companies’ own conditions, with that component dropping 0.5 point to 43.3. In contrast, the assessment of Brazil’s economic conditions rose 0.3 point to 33.3.

Swiss Bond Yields Reach Two-Week High — The yield on the Swiss 10-year government bond rose to 0.57%, reaching its highest level in two weeks, tracking higher US Treasury yields following stronger-than-expected inflation that raised bets of a Fed rate hike in October. In Switzerland, inflation rose to a two-year high of 1% in September, mainly due to higher energy prices amid the prolonged Middle East conflict, but remained within the Swiss National Bank’s 0–2% target range. The SNB kept its policy rate at 0% in September, while Vice Chairman Martin said no rate adjustment is currently needed, citing low and stable inflation and limited spillover risks, as the Swiss economy was working "very well". Most economists expect the policy rate to remain unchanged through 2027, although markets continue to price in a rate hike by year-end and roughly three hikes by the end of 2027.

Also, average feedgas deliveries to the nine major US liquefied natural gas export terminals eased to 17.5 billion cubic feet per day so far this month, down from 17.9 bcfd in September. On the other hand, domestic production in the Lower 48 states declined to 110.8 bcfd in October, compared with record averages of 113.3 bcfd in August and September. The reduction reflected hurricane-related Gulf of Mexico shut-ins, force majeure events and pipeline disruptions in several states. Baltic Dry Index Down for 8th Day — The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk freight index, which tracks rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, continued to decline for the eighth consecutive session on Wednesday, slipping about 4.8% to its lowest since July 29 at 2,667 points. The capesize index, which typically transports 150,000-ton cargoes, including iron ore and coal, plunged 9.1% to its lowest level since late June at 3,630 points. Concurrently, the panamax index, which usually carries 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, dropped roughly 1% to 2,409 points. Among smaller vessels, the supramax index rose 0.7% to 1,845 points.

TSX Falls as Banks and Miners Slide — The S&P/TSX Composite Index fell nearly 1% to trade below 36,000, weighed down by losses in the banking and mining sectors. Oil prices extended gains, fueling concerns over energy-driven inflation, while higher-than-expected US CPI inflation pressured lenders amid uncertainty over the Fed’s policy outlook. Major banks declined, with RBC, TD Bank, BMO and CIBC losing about 1% each. Miners extended their losses as gold and silver prices continued to fall, with Agnico Eagle down more than 4.5%, Barrick shedding over 3.5% and WPM losing nearly 4.5%. In contrast, energy producers gained as oil prices resumed their climb, with Suncor and Imperial Oil rising around 0.5%. On the data front, construction intentions in Canada rose 8.8% in August from July, well above expectations for a 2.9% increase. WSP Global edged higher, while AtkinsRéalis rose more than 0.5%. Technology stocks were mostly higher, with Shopify up 1%. Retailers also advanced, with ATD gaining 1.5% and Loblaw rising 1%.

Italy's BTP Yield Rebounds — Italy’s 10-year BTP yield climbed to 4.58%, tracking higher US Treasury yields after higher-than-expected inflation data that raised bets of a Fed rate hike in October. In Europe, ECB President Largarde stated that no sign of second-round effects of high energy prices on inflation were seen yet, although caution remains of persistent inflationary pressures. As such, markets continue to expect a ECB hike in December. In Italy, its largest business lobby, Confindustria, has warned of a worsening energy shock. While its Italian economic growth forecasts for 2026 match the government's at 1%, growth for 2027 is seen lower at 0.6%, as the phaseout of free EU carbon permits could lead to loss of capacity and company closures. This adds to concerns over Italy's 2027 budget plan that's set to be above the EU's 3% of GDP limit, on optimistic growth assumptions. Italy’s debt-to-GDP ratio, currently at 138.6%, is also expected to surpass Greece’s this year as the eurozone’s most indebted country.

【TIMIRAOS: core inf above forecasts, bolstering case for another Fed hike this year】TIMIRAOS said September core CPI (ex-food and energy) rose 0.33% MoM, above nearly all Wall Street forecasts and up from 0.29% in August, marking a second consecutive month of stronger-than-expected inf. He said the report reinforces the case for the Federal Reserve to raise rates again this year; Fed officials unanimously voted to hike last month and most had expected one more increase in the year. The release raises two policy questions: whether officials can wait until December to act after saying they do not expect to change rates at the meeting in two weeks, and how high policy rates ultimately need to go — a judgement that depends on whether rising energy costs and AI-driven investment pressures spread into the broader economy. Officials have not signalled they would revise plans based on a single report.

【美聯儲傳聲筒 Nick Timiraos：CPI超預期令美聯儲10月按兵不動面臨更大壓力，但尚無跡象表明官員將改變利率決策計劃】美聯儲傳聲筒，名記Nick Timiraos釋出文章指出，美國9月核心通脹連續第二個月超出預期，進一步強化了美聯儲年內再加息一次的理由。美聯儲官員上月一致投票決定加息時，幾乎所有官員都在利率預測中預計今年還將加息一次。剔除食品和能源價格的美國9月核心消費者價格指數（CPI）環比上漲0.33%，高於華爾街經濟學家幾乎所有預測值，8月漲幅為0.29%。
這份通脹報告給美聯儲官員帶來了兩個問題。
首先，更迫切的問題是，美聯儲是否仍有餘地等到12月再加息。此前，美聯儲官員釋放訊號，表示預計不會在兩週後的政策會議上調整利率。一些分析人士認為，如果美聯儲官員本就預計需要進一步加息，那麼沒有太多理由繼續等待。不過，目前尚無跡象表明，官員們會因為單獨一份通脹報告而重新考慮近期的政策安排。
其次，也是更重要的問題，是利率最終需要上升到多高。這將取決於能源價格上漲和人工智慧投資熱潮帶來的通脹壓力，是否正在向更廣泛的經濟領域蔓延。

UK Gilt Yields Near 2007 Highs — The UK 10-year gilt yield rose to 5.46%, nearing its highest level since July 2007, tracking higher US Treasury yields after stronger-than-expected US inflation boosted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month. Meanwhile, BoE Chief Economist Huw Pill expressed skepticism about market expectations for four rate increases over the coming year, arguing that stronger evidence was needed to justify a larger hike despite the need to address the energy shock triggered by the Iran war. Governor Andrew Bailey, however, warned that a rate increase would become increasingly difficult to avoid if the energy shock persists. Markets see a near-100% chance of a BoE rate hike in November, its first in over three years, though expectations for four increases by June 2027 have eased slightly. Separately, the IMF urged the UK government to clarify how it will fund higher defense spending, with an additional £11 billion annually needed to raise military expenditure to 3% of GDP by 2030.

Swiss Franc Weakens to 17-Month Low — The Swiss franc weakened toward 0.84 per USD, reaching its lowest level in seventeen months following stronger-than-expected US inflation data that raised bets of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve in October and boosted demand for the greenback. In contrast, the Swiss National Bank is expected to leave its policy rate unchanged at 0%, while its Vice Chairman Martin said no adjustment was currently needed, citing low and stable inflation and limited spillover risks, as the Swiss economy was working "very well". Policymakers have also scaled back threats of currency intervention. Swiss borrowing costs have remained at the world’s lowest for over a year, increasing it’s appeal as a funding source for carry trades as interest-rate differentials with other major economies widen. As traders take short positions, the selling pressure of franc-loans weakens the currency.

Bund Yields Rebound After Strong US Inflation — Germany’s 10-year Bund yield climbed to 3.49%, tracking higher US Treasury yields after stronger-than-expected US inflation data showed consumer prices and core inflation rising more than anticipated in September, increasing the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month. Markets now see around a 50% chance of a hike, up from roughly 22% before the report. Meanwhile, ECB President Christine Lagarde said elevated energy-driven inflation has yet to spread across the broader euro-area economy, supporting a wait-and-see approach. However, persistent inflation surprises and the ongoing US-Iran conflict have prompted markets to price in another ECB rate hike in December. Bond markets have shown tentative signs of stabilization following a global sell-off in late September and early October, but persistent concerns over energy prices, inflation and rising borrowing costs, alongside fiscal pressures in more heavily indebted countries, continue to weigh on sentiment.

Sterling Falls to Late-June Lows — Sterling fell below $1.32, returning to levels last seen in late June, as stronger-than-expected US inflation reduced expectations of the Federal Reserve holding rates steady in October. US inflation rose to 3.7% year-on-year in September, above forecasts of 3.6%, while core inflation also exceeded expectations. Meanwhile, investors assessed comments from Bank of England policymakers, with Chief Economist Huw Pill expressing skepticism about market expectations for four rate hikes over the coming year and arguing that stronger evidence was needed to justify a larger increase despite the need to address the energy shock triggered by the Iran war. Governor Andrew Bailey, however, warned that a rate hike would become harder to avoid the longer the shock persists. Markets are pricing in a near-100% chance of the BoE delivering its first rate hike in more than three years in November. However, expectations for four 25-basis-point increases by June 2027 have eased slightly.

【Netflix to cut about 6% of workforce globally】Netflix (NFLX.O) will cut roughly 6% of its global workforce, about 1,000 roles, its largest layoff since 2022 as growth slows and user engagement declines. Euro Hits 16-Month Low — The euro tumbled to $1.11, touching its weakest level since May 2025, as investors flocked to the US dollar following stronger-than-expected inflation data that reduced the likelihood of the Federal Reserve holding rates steady in October. US inflation rose to 3.7% year-on-year in September, above forecasts of 3.6%, while core inflation also exceeded expectations. Markets now see around a 50% chance of the Fed keeping rates unchanged this month, down from over 78% before the report. Meanwhile, expectations that the ECB will delay further rate hikes until December, alongside concerns over the impact of rising inflation and borrowing costs on economic growth, continued to weigh on the common currency. Fiscal pressures in highly indebted countries, particularly France, added to the downside risks. ECB President Christine Lagarde noted that elevated energy-driven inflation has yet to spread across the broader euro-area economy, reinforcing the case for a wait-and-see approach.

【UN warns US‑Iran impasse on Hormuz fertilizer plan could trigger food‑security shock in Asia, Africa】Refinitiv reports a UN official leading a UN fertilizer‑shipping initiative warned that if the US and Iran do not agree within weeks on a UN‑backed plan to move fertilizer through the Strait of Hormuz, parts of Asia and Africa could face a food‑security crisis. The UN created a working group in March and has drafted a mechanism that remains unimplemented. The proposal would set up a UN coordination center in Oman to register vessels and coordinate safe transit; UN monitors would verify cargoes with Gulf port authorities. The UN deputy secretary‑general said five vessels per day would be sufficient to sustain supplies to needy countries; vessels would be tracked in transit and subject to additional inspections if concerns arise.

Silver Falls Below $58 — Silver prices fell below $58 an ounce on Wednesday, hitting their lowest level since early August, as stronger-than-expected US inflation prompted investors to reassess the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate outlook. US inflation climbed to 3.7% year-on-year in September, above forecasts of 3.6%, driven by higher energy prices. Monthly CPI rose 0.6%, its largest increase in five months, while core inflation also exceeded expectations, reaching 2.6% annually and 0.3% monthly. According to LSEG data, markets now see around a 50% chance of the Fed holding rates steady in October, down from over 78% before the report. Meanwhile, the probability of a rate hike in December has risen to nearly 99%, from 88% previously. Although recent Fed communications had offered little indication of consecutive rate hikes, the stronger-than-expected core CPI reading has brought an October move back into consideration, weighing on non-yielding precious metals such as silver.

Gold Slides as Strong US Inflation Fuels Rate Hike Bets — Gold prices fell below $4,100 an ounce on Wednesday, hitting their lowest level since early August, as a stronger-than-expected US inflation report prompted markets to reassess the Federal Reserve’s rate outlook. US inflation rose to 3.7% year-on-year in September, above forecasts of 3.6%, driven by higher energy prices. Monthly CPI increased 0.6%, its biggest gain in five months, while core inflation also exceeded expectations, reaching 2.6% annually and 0.3% monthly. According to LSEG data, markets now see around a 50% chance of the Fed holding rates steady at its October meeting, down from more than 78% before the report. Meanwhile, the probability of a rate hike in December has risen to nearly 99%, from 88% previously. Although recent Fed communications had offered little indication of a back-to-back rate hike in October, the larger-than-expected increase in core CPI has brought that possibility back into focus, adding further pressure on non-yielding gold.

【Japan to fund up to $21 bln for GlobalFoundries US fabs; US to take roughly 4% stake】GlobalFoundries will build two fabs on its existing site in upstate New York with up to $21 billion of Japanese financing, according to an agreement announced Wednesday. The plants will be jointly held by the United States and Japan, and the U.S. government will acquire about a 4% stake in GlobalFoundries. Construction funding will come from Japan’s previously pledged $550 billion of investment in the U.S. The new facilities will produce foundational chips—lower-complexity but widely used semiconductors for autos, industrial equipment and communications—to boost U.S. supply and reduce reliance on East Asian vendors. The deal is pitched as a response to U.S. national-security concerns and to ease base-chip tightness intensified as industry capacity shifts toward advanced AI accelerators such as NVIDIA’s.

Canada Building Permits Rebound in August — Canada’s building permits rose 8.8% month-on-month to C$13.6 billion in August 2026, rebounding from a revised 15.8% decline in July and exceeding forecasts for a 2.6% increase. The recovery was led by the residential sector, where permit values rose C$1.1 billion to C$8.5 billion. The increase was driven by the multi-unit component, which climbed C$1.1 billion to C$5.8 billion, while the single-family component edged down C$0.7 million to C$2.6 billion. Meanwhile, the value of non-residential building permits fell C$29.8 million to C$5.1 billion. US Core CPI Rises More than Expected — Core consumer prices in the United States, which exclude food and energy, rose by 0.3% from the previous month in September of 2026, the same pace as August, and ahead of median market expectations of a 0.2% increase. Consumer prices rose sharply for shelter (0.4% vs 0.3% in August) and transportation services (0.6% vs 0.5%), the most in six months to suggest that soaring energy prices are being transmitted through the transportation and logistics sector. Meanwhile, the CPI rebounded for medical care services (0.3% vs -0.2%). From the previous year, the core inflation rate was at 2.6%.

【美國9月CPI出爐 美國9月CPI上漲3.7%】當地時間14日，美國勞工統計局公佈的資料顯示，美國9月消費者價格指數（CPI）同比上漲3.7%，剔除食品和能源價格後的核心CPI同比上漲2.6% 。 分析人士表示，汽油和柴油價格高企是美國9月整體通脹抬升的核心推手之一。根據美國汽車協會的資料，截至10月9日，美國全國柴油平均零售價約為每加侖6.3美元，較美伊衝突前上漲近70%。《金融時報》報道稱，柴油價格高企推高企業貨運成本，美國商超的食品價格面臨新一輪上漲壓力，百事、康尼格拉等美國食品龍頭企業陸續宣佈產品提價。  （央視財經）

US Inflation Rate Tops Forecasts — The US annual inflation rate accelerated to 3.7% in September 2026, up from 3.4% in each of the previous two months and above market expectations of 3.6%, driven by higher energy prices. Gasoline rose 34.2% yoy, more than 27.4% in August and fuel oil prices increased 74.2%, compared with 52% previously. Inflation also accelerated for shelter, to 3.2% from 3%, but slowed for food to 2.5% from 2.7%. On a monthly basis, the CPI went up 0.6%, marking its largest gain in five months, compared to 0.4% in August and in line with forecasts. Gasoline jumped 9.1%, accounting for over half of the monthly all items increase. Recreation, used cars and trucks, education, airline fares, medical care, and apparel also went up while food prices steadied and communication declined. Meanwhile, annual core inflation rate went up to 2.6% from 2.4%, more than forecasts of 2.5% while monthly core CPI inflation steadied at 0.3%, the same as in August and defying forecasts it would slow to 0.2%.

【圖靈量子、智城算網、亞洲算力將共建粵港澳大灣區首個量超智融合算力中心】10月14日，在2026灣芯展上，上海圖靈智算量子科技股份有限公司、深圳市智城算網科技有限公司與亞洲算力算網與量子計算科技有限公司簽署戰略合作協議，計劃共建粵港澳大灣區首個量超智融合算力中心，打造融合量子計算、高效能運算與人工智慧的新型算力基礎設施。據介紹，亞洲算力將提供資料中心規劃建設、基礎設施交付及運營服務；智城算網將依託超智通算力排程平臺，接入並排程多元異構算力資源；圖靈量子則將以其TuringQ Gen3大規模晶片級可擴充套件光量子計算機提供光量子算力，作為中心的算力單元之一，與經典算力協同支援複雜計算任務。

Poland’s Trade Deficit Hits €3.05 Billion in August — Poland’s trade deficit widened sharply to €3.05 billion in August 2026 from €2.16 billion in the same month a year earlier. It is the second highest trade gap since a record deficit in February 2022. Imports rose 15.4% year-on-year to €31.60 billion, driven mainly by higher purchases of computer hardware, parts and components, and integrated circuits, while higher fuel prices boosted purchases of crude oil and petroleum products. Imports of aircraft engines and consumer durables also increased. Meanwhile, exports rose at a slower 13.2% to €28.56 billion, supported by stronger shipments of computer hardware, aircraft engines, petroleum products and raw silver. However, sales from the automotive industry declined, and furniture sales fell again.

Poland Posts Largest Current Account Deficit on Record — Poland recorded a current account deficit of €3,567 million in August 2026, the largest on record, widening sharply from a revised €2,661 million in the same month a year earlier. The goods trade deficit expanded to €3,047 million, its highest level in more than four years, as imports rose 15.4%, outpacing the 13.2% increase in exports. The primary income deficit widened to €3,780 million from €3,614 million, largely reflecting outflows to foreign direct investors on their investments in Polish entities, alongside income payments on portfolio and other investments. Meanwhile, the services surplus narrowed to €3,003 million from €3,304 million. In contrast, the secondary income account swung to a surplus of €257 million, compared with a deficit of €193 million a year earlier.

【德外長：將把“北溪”爆炸案審判結果納入政治考量】德國外交部長瓦德富爾當地時間10月14日表示，德國政府將等待“北溪”天然氣管道爆炸案的審判結果，並將其納入今後的政治考量。瓦德富爾當天在柏林與保加利亞外長舉行聯合新聞釋出會。在被問及如果審判證實烏克蘭國家機構參與策劃“北溪”管道爆炸事件，德國是否會調整對烏關係及援助政策時，瓦德富爾表示，目前尚不清楚審判結果，德國政府將尊重司法程式，等待法院作出裁決。他強調，審判應當在不受政治干預的情況下進行。無論審判結果如何，德國政府都會將其納入政治考量，並在結果公佈後表明立場。瓦德富爾還提到，烏克蘭總統此前曾否認爆炸行動由烏克蘭官方授意進行。2022年“北溪”天然氣管道爆炸案當天在德國漢堡高等地區法院首次開庭審理。烏克蘭籍男子謝爾蓋·K因涉嫌參與策劃和實施爆炸行動出庭受審。（央視新聞）

【IBM 與西門子聯合推進奈米堆疊電晶體架構研發】IBM 與西門子宣佈達成研發合作，共同推進 IBM 的奈米堆疊（Nanostack）架構，整合 IBM 的半導體器件技術積累與西門子電子設計自動化（EDA）及製造軟體能力。IBM 負責半導體器件創新；西門子提供 EDA 工具、工藝模擬、光刻最佳化以及先進製造軟體。 奈米堆疊屬於基於奈米片的三維設計，電晶體採用垂直堆疊方式。在 7 埃工藝節點下，指甲大小的晶片可整合約 1000 億個電晶體。雙方合作將搭建奈米堆疊的高階虛擬模型，在流片之前最佳化設計、解決製造難題。

【農發行已提前安排秋糧收購專項信貸資金2000億元】記者10月14日從中國農業發展銀行獲悉，目前，農發行已提前安排2000億元信貸資金專項用於今年秋糧收購。農發行表示，秋糧產量約佔全年糧食總產量的四分之三，做好秋糧收購信貸工作意義重大。日前，農發行召開2026年秋糧收購信貸工作座談會，分析研判今年秋糧生產與收購形勢，專題部署秋糧收購信貸工作。農發行稱，各級行將按照“保收儲、提份額、促發展，建客群、優服務、控風險”工作要求，統籌支援好政策性收儲和市場化收購，加大貸款投放力度，切實守住農民“種糧賣得出”底線。同時，積極延鏈拓業，著力打造全產業鏈金融服務格局，提升服務國家糧食安全深度和廣度。（新華社）

US Futures Hold Ground Ahead of CPI — US stock futures were mostly higher on Wednesday, as the prospect of robust earnings offset persistent volatility in chipmaker stocks ahead of the key US inflation print and major earnings results. Contracts for the S&P 500 and Dow were slightly higher, while those for the Nasdaq 100 inched below the flatline. Morgan Stanley was 1% higher premarket after its equity trading revenue topped forecasts, and BlackRock edged up after pulling in more capital in its asset management business, boosting fee revenue. On the other hand, AI infrastructure stocks fell further as ASML stated it could not keep up with fab demand, while Chinese competitors signaled improved products. Micron and Marvell fell more than 2% each. Gauges of underlying inflation ahead of the US CPI release are expected to have remained elevated in September, backing calls from multiple FOMC members that more rate hikes could be warranted this year.
State Street earnings above expectations at 3.69 USD — State Street (STT) released earnings per share at 3.69 USD, compared to market expectations of 3.41 USD.

US Mortgage Applications Extend 20-Month Low — The volume of mortgage applications in the US fell by 2.7% in the week ending October 9th, marking the sixth consecutive decline to the lowest level since January 2025, according to data from the Mortgage Bankers Association. The drop tracked a sharp increase in mortgage rates over the period, as the benchmark 30-year fixed rate averaged a near-three-year high of 7.5%. Yields on long-term securities continued to surge at the turn of the month despite Treasury efforts to tame the long end by increasing bill issuance and expanding buybacks of nominal notes and bonds. Applications to refinance a loan, which are sensitive to short-term changes in interest rates, fell by 0.45% from the previous week, while purchase applications declined by 0.40%.

Bank of Uganda Delivers Massive Rate Hike — The Bank of Uganda raised its benchmark interest rate by a massive 225 basis points to 12% at an emergency meeting on October 14, 2026, following an extended pause in monetary tightening. The move pushed borrowing costs to their highest level since 2017, as the central bank sought to curb the shilling’s sharp depreciation. Governor Michael Atingi-Ego said the continued depreciation could fuel inflationary pressures, warranting a tighter monetary policy stance. Uganda's inflation rose for a sixth straight month to 4.6% in September, reaching its highest level since June 2023. The shilling has lost around 12% this year, hitting successive record lows against the US dollar this month, amid strong demand for foreign currency from oil importers and foreign investors selling government bonds. The central bank had proposed using Uganda’s $6 billion in foreign reserves to ease dollar shortages, but President Yoweri Museveni opposed the move over concerns about its impact on importers.

US Mortgage Rates Rise for 8th Straight Week — The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate edged up 1 basis points to 7.5% in the week ended October 9, 2026, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association. It marked an eighth straight weekly increase, bringing the cumulative rise to 141 basis points since US-Israeli strikes against Iran began in late February. Borrowing costs continue to track elevated US Treasury yields amid expectations that the Federal Reserve will need to keep interest rates higher for longer to bring inflation under control. This upward movement has weighed heavily on the housing sector. Total mortgage applications fell 2.7%, extending their decline to a sixth consecutive week. Refinancing applications dropped 0.4%, while purchase applications fell 4%.

Italy's BTP Yield Holds at One-Week Low — Italy’s 10-year BTP yield eased to 4.54%, remaining near a one-week low while tracking a broader decline in global bond yields. ECB President Largarde stated that no sign of second-round effects of high energy prices on inflation were seen yet, although caution remains of persistent inflationary pressures. As such, markets continue to expect a ECB hike in December. In Italy, its largest business lobby, Confindustria, has warned of the impact of a worsening energy shock on Italian economic growth. While its forecasts for 2026 match the government's at 1%, growth for 2027 is seen lower at 0.6%, as the phaseout of free EU carbon permits could lead to loss of capacity and further company closures. This adds to concerns over Italy's 2027 budget plan that's set to be above the EU's 3% of GDP limit, on optimistic growth assumptions. Italy’s debt-to-GDP ratio, currently at 138.6%, is also expected to surpass Greece’s this year as the eurozone’s most indebted country.

Sensex Finishes Lower — India’s BSE Sensex closed about 0.3% down at 72,781.9 on Wednesday, reversing the prior session's rally, partly due to profit-booking. Meanwhile, market sentiment was pressured by the renewed increase in oil prices, geopolitical uncertainties and sustained foreign outflows. Foreign portfolio investors extended their selling streak to 13 sessions on Tuesday, taking year-to-date outflows to a record $32.52 billion. Investors also exerted caution ahead of US inflation data, while also monitoring the ongoing earnings season. Among the major laggards, Bajaj Finance fell 2.6%, M&M lost 2.2%, Bajaj Finserv dropped 2%, Eternal declined 1.7% and ICICI Bank slipped 1.5%. Conversely, tech stocks maintained strong performance, led by Infosys, which rose 2.5%, followed by Tech Mahindra (+2.2%), TCS (+1.5%) and HCLTech (+0.6%). The sector attracted strong investor interest following HCLTech’s quarterly profit, which came in above market expectations. FMGC and oil & gas stocks also advanced.

Aluminum Falls to Year-to-Date Low — Aluminum futures in the UK fell to $3,020 per tonne in October, the lowest level year-to-date, fully erasing the rally since the start of the war between Iran and the US amid a stronger dollar and ample supply outside the Middle East. Aluminum smelting infrastructure in the Middle East was restarted at a faster pace than previously signaled following damage to facilities and operational halts caused by disruptions to natural gas production chains in the region. Emirates Global Aluminium said that a quarter of its Al Taweelah smelter in Abu Dhabi had resumed operations. In addition, Rio Tinto secured an agreement to keep its Bell Bay Aluminium smelter in Tasmania operational through the end of 2031, further boosting supply prospects. Also, China's exports have increased sharply in the period despite the 30% export duty faced by primary aluminum smelters, which drives secondary producers to focus on foreign markets. Alloy export volumes doubled y-o-y to 4.46 million tons through August.

French Bond Yields Ease Ahead of US Inflation — France’s 10-year OAT yield eased to 4.82% as investors awaited US inflation data for fresh clues on the Federal Reserve’s rate path. Despite the decline, borrowing costs remain near their highest levels in more than two decades, amid concerns over record public debt and political obstacles to fiscal consolidation. The government aims to reduce the budget deficit to 5% of GDP by 2027, but securing parliamentary support for significant spending cuts remains uncertain ahead of next year’s presidential election. Meanwhile, ECB President Christine Lagarde said elevated energy-driven inflation has yet to spread across the broader euro-area economy, supporting a wait-and-see approach. However, persistent inflation pressures and the ongoing US-Iran conflict have prompted markets to price in another ECB rate hike in December, following two increases earlier this year.
